messages:
maria (docs): Heads up: customers hit errors after the embed model switch — some examples now return 256-d vectors instead of 128.
aj (sdk): Which examples?
maria (docs): quickstarts/js/embedding-snippet.md and onboarding/embeddings.md plus a few sample outputs in docs. CI smoke tests assert 128.
kevin (eng): We set v2 as default for quality. There's an alias but docs still reference the old id.
sara (pm): Action: patch docs, add migration note, and a small SDK guard.
aj (sdk): I'll add a check that throws a clear error when dim mismatch. Snippet: ```js
const e = await client.embeddings.create(...);
if (e.data[0].embedding.length !== 256) {
  throw new Error('Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 256. See /docs/migrate/embed-dim');
}
```
maria (docs): Paste exact error text when ready; I'll use verbatim in the callout and update sample outputs for CI.
aj (sdk): SDK PR incoming EOD with test.
kevin (eng): I'll add a temporary alias mapping old_id -> new_v2 for two weeks and an opt-in legacy flag. Backend PR linked in thread when ready.
maria (docs): I'll open a WIP docs PR with callout and updated snippets and mark as docs/migration.
docs-bot: Reminder: add labels [docs/migration] and [priority/medium] to PR.
sara (pm): Thanks all. Keep links & final error string in this thread. :thumbsup:
